messages:
maria_devex: FYI a customer on our hosted plan filed a support ticket: their Python app running under gunicorn (pre-fork) is showing a spike in "unattributed" quota usage in the console. They traced it to SDK v1.9.0.

rachel_ts: did they capture logs?

maria_devex: yes — they dumped logs and saw the SDK sampler thread sending usage before route negotiation completed. Repro snippet they shared: 
```python
# gunicorn --workers 3 --worker-class gevent
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(token="XXX", enable_sampler=True)
# app forks after import; sometimes sampler runs in parent before headers set
```

sam_engineering: I can repro locally. root cause: we initialize background sampler in Client.__init__ which races with the middleware that attaches per-route headers (route negotiation happens during first request). In pre-fork servers the sampler may run in parent and send requests lacking route headers.

tom_go: is this just Python? any evidence of TS/Go SDKs doing the same?

rachel_ts: TS doesn't start background threads by default; Go has a background flusher but it's started lazily on first request. looks Python-specific.

jenna_sre: Ops suggestion: server-side fallback is cheap: if headers missing, tag as tenant-unrouted and emit metric. That gives immediate relief while client patch rolls out.

sam_engineering: Agreed. Propose two-prong fix: (A) server: routing-service maps missing headers to "unrouted" + metric quota.attr.unrouted; (B) client: change py-sdk to lazily start sampler on first outbound request or when client.ready() invoked. Also detect gunicorn pre-fork and log a warning at import time.

maria_devex: timeline? customers will want a patch quickly.

sam_engineering: I'll prepare a py-sdk 1.9.1 hotfix today implementing lazy-start. Simple patch: move _start_sampler call out of __init__ and call on first send() if not started. Pseudodiff:
```diff
- def __init__(...):
-     if self.config.sampler:
-         self._start_sampler()
+ def __init__(...):
+     # don't start background threads during import/fork; start on demand
+     self._sampler_started = False
+
+ def _ensure_sampler(self):
+     if not self._sampler_started and self.config.sampler:
+         self._start_sampler()
+         self._sampler_started = True

+ def _send(self, ...):
+     self._ensure_sampler()
+     # proceed to send
```

sam_engineering: I'll include a short note about gunicorn pre-fork in the changelog and the upgrade guide.

rachel_ts: For safety, can we add an env var RW_ALLOW_PREFORK_START for customers who intentionally want sampler in parent? keep default safe.

sam_engineering: makes sense. default is safe; env var opt-in.

jenna_sre: I'll roll server fallback to canary today and add an alert when quota.attr.unrouted > 0.1% of total requests.

observability-bot: [metric] quota.attr.unrouted +1 (canary)
deploy-bot: deploy started: routing-service/canary -> v2.15.0 at 2025-10-15T14:30:00Z

maria_devex: can we also add a console UX tile "Requests with missing routing headers" (top endpoints) so CS can contact impacted customers?

rachel_ts: I'll file a Console ticket and wire it to the support view.

sam_engineering: PR opened: py-sdk #5010, tests included simulating fork+thread timing. Cutting 1.9.1-rc.

maria_devex: posting to #announcements after RC promoted. Also will draft a short KB article about gunicorn + RW SDK best practices.

jenna_sre: follow-ups: (1) monitor quota.attr.unrouted for 72h post-canary; (2) validate py-sdk 1.9.1 on our sample customers; (3) remove server fallback after 30 days if rates <0.01%

maria_devex: noted. thanks everyone — small impact but good catch. :tada:
